opening.argument: The video explains Avalanche as a blockchain platform for decentralized applications and custom networks, then describes the distinct roles of its three chains. That technical context matters: the statement that users staking at least 2,000 AVAX can earn up to 11.5% annually appears within an overview of how the platform works, not as a guaranteed return. The material provides no payment destination, requests no credentials, and claims no completed transaction. The observable content supports an educational account of the platform and its staking mechanics, without establishing any viewer loss or deceptive outcome.

citations.quote: Avalanche is a first-layer blockchain platform designed for decentralized applications and custom blockchain networks.

Each chain serves a specific purpose: X-Chain handles asset creation and exchange, C-Chain enables developers to build EVM-compatible smart contracts, and P-Chain coordinates validators and manages subnets for customized blockchain networks.
Users who stake a minimum of 2,000 AVAX can earn up to 11.5% annual rewards
